$comment: TRACKED project settings. This file is in git ON PURPOSE: it is therefore present in
every `git worktree` from the moment the worktree is created, which is the only way a
guard can reach a seat running in one. `.claude/settings.local.json` is personal and
gitignored; hooks that must follow the repo belong HERE.
`.claude/agent-memory` symlink, so a seat's memory write silently created a real local
directory that died with the worktree. The PreToolUse hook blocks that write BEFORE any
byte lands; the SessionStart hook warns the seat before it writes anything at all. Both
name `.claude/setup-agent-memory.sh`, which fixes it in one command.
The hook is silent and exits 0 on every tool call that is not a memory write.
